Cross-sectional ranking via alpha_score is closed for new alpha on robust broad-universe evidence: the edge shrinks when the universe broadens (the opposite of a generalizable alpha) and the only tilt is single-regime (late_strong). prediction.confidence_reason: New evidence is exp-20260620-020's measured core beta/alpha attribution, not another candidate-source or threshold sweep.
